disable_progress_bars: disable progress bars globally or for a named group using a context manager or direct call
enable_progress_bars: enable progress bars globally or for a specific named group
are_progress_bars_disabled: check whether progress bars are disabled globally or for a specific group name
tqdm_stream_file: stream a file with a progress bar by wrapping its read method via a context manager
tqdm: create a tqdm progress bar that respects global and group-based disable settings
